title: 第一卷 第28章 小人寻衅，随手镇杀
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
石洞灵脉枯竭，滋养彻底落幕。

    苏玄尘收稳周身气息，撤去遮挡洞口的碎石。

    一缕林间清风灌入洞中，驱散了狭小空间内的凝滞灵气。

    他缓缓起身，体态依旧看似微微佝偻，气息平淡如常。

    从外表看去，依旧是那个修为普通、年岁垂暮的白发老者。

    无人知晓，短短半个时辰的灵脉温养，已经让他的根基愈发浑厚扎实。

    肉身暗伤尽数抚平，经脉通透无瑕。

    同阶修士的底蕴，早已远远无法与他相比。

    走出石洞，崖壁周遭依旧冷清。

    整片西侧荒壁，依旧无人踏足，安静得只剩风吹杂草的轻响。

    苏玄尘正准备移步，去往幽谷边缘继续搜寻散落资源。

    两道身影，恰好从山路拐角绕行过来，径直堵住了他的去路。

    来人是两名外门弟子，身着青衫，面带阴翳。

    修为皆在炼气五层，气息躁动，眼神透着不加掩饰的恶意。

    这两人，都是林辰身边的跟班。

    平日里在外门横行惯了，仗着背靠外门第一天才，素来欺凌弱小，抢占资源。

    此前秘境大战，他们不敢掺和天骄争锋。

    只能在外围游荡闲逛，顺带四处游荡碰运气。

    无意间瞥见崖壁石洞走出的白发身影，两人当即驻足。

    看清是苏玄尘的一刻，眼底瞬间涌出浓烈的贪意与轻视。

    “原来是这百岁老东西。”

    “躲在这种荒无人烟的破角落，倒是会苟活。”

    两人低声嘲讽，语气刻薄至极。

    在他们眼中，苏玄尘空有天灵根名头，终究只是个朽木老者。

    修为低微，年岁垂暮，战力不堪一击。

    先前聚灵泉对峙，他们只当是林辰有意放水。

    只当对方是靠着诡异韧性撑住威压，真实战力不值一提。

    “所有人都在核心抢高阶灵草、抢秘境残页。”

    “唯独他躲在角落摸鱼，三天下来，怕是攒了不少零碎资源。”

    “正好没人看见，咱们把他的东西抢了！”

    两人对视一眼，瞬间打定主意。

    秘境之中，无人管束。

    天骄战场他们不敢掺和，拿捏一个百岁老朽，毫无风险。

    若是能抢下对方积攒的资源，也算不虚此行。

    甚至回去之后，还能借着打压“宗门重点天才”的名头，在外门博一波名气。

    一举两得。

    心念既定，两名弟子快步上前，直接封死前路。
content_en:
The spiritual veins of the stone cave are exhausted, and the nourishment has completely ended.

    Su Xuanchen calmed down his aura and removed the rubble blocking the entrance of the cave.

    A wisp of breeze flowed into the cave, dispersing the stagnant spiritual energy in the small space.

    He stood up slowly, his body still looked slightly rickety, and his breath was as calm as usual.

    From the outside, he is still the white-haired old man with ordinary cultivation and aging.

    No one knew that just half an hour of nourishing his spiritual veins had already made his foundation stronger and more solid.

    All the hidden wounds on the physical body were healed, and the meridians were clear and flawless.

    The background of monks at the same level is far beyond his comparison.

    After walking out of the cave, the area around the cliff was still deserted.

    The entire deserted wall on the west side was still untouched by anyone, and it was so quiet that the only sound left was the gentle sound of the wind blowing the weeds.

    Su Xuanchen was about to move to the edge of the valley to continue searching for scattered resources.

    Two figures happened to come around the corner of the mountain road and blocked his way.

    The visitors were two outer disciples, dressed in green shirts and with gloomy faces.

    They are all at the fifth level of Qi Refining, their auras are restless, and their eyes reveal undisguised malice.

    These two people are Lin Chen's followers.

    On weekdays, he is used to running rampant in the outer sect. With his backing to the top genius in the outer sect, he always bullies the weak and seizes resources.

    In the previous battle in the secret realm, they did not dare to join in the competition between the geniuses.

    I can only wander around the periphery and try my luck by wandering around.

    Inadvertently catching a glimpse of the white-haired figure coming out of the cave on the cliff, the two of them stopped immediately.

    The moment he saw clearly that it was Su Xuanchen, strong greed and contempt suddenly emerged from his eyes.

    "It turns out to be this hundred-year-old guy."

    "You can survive by hiding in such a deserted corner."

    The two men jeered in low voices, their tone extremely mean.

    In their eyes, Su Xuanchen had no reputation but was just a rotten old man after all.

    His cultivation level is low, he is old and his fighting power is weak.

    During the previous confrontation at Ju Lingquan, they just assumed that Lin Chen was deliberately releasing the water.

    As long as the opponent relies on weird resilience to hold up the pressure, the actual combat power is not worth mentioning.

    "Everyone is grabbing high-level spiritual herbs and secret realm fragments in the core."

    "He was the only one who hid in a corner and fished. After three days, he probably accumulated a lot of scattered resources."

    "It just so happened that no one saw it, so let's snatch his things!"

    The two looked at each other and made up their minds instantly.

    In the secret realm, no one controls it.

    They dare not interfere in the Tianjiao battlefield, and there is no risk in taking advantage of a hundred-year-old man.

    If you can seize the resources accumulated by the opponent, it will be a worthwhile trip.

    Even after returning, he can gain fame in the outer sect by suppressing the "key geniuses of the sect".

    Kill two birds with one stone.

    With their thoughts in mind, the two disciples quickly stepped forward and blocked the way forward.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 28 The villain picks a fight and kills him casually
